anthropic.title: How to get your Anthropic key
anthropic.step2: Click **Create Key** and name it, for example "Rerun".
anthropic.step3: Copy the key (it starts with `sk-ant-`) and paste it above. It is shown only once.

openai.title: How to get your OpenAI key
openai.step2: Click **Create new secret key** and name it, for example "Rerun".
openai.step3: Copy the key (it starts with `sk-`) and paste it above. It is shown only once.

google.title: How to get your Google key
google.step1: Open [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) and sign in with your Google account.
google.step2: Click **Create API key** and pick a Google Cloud project.
google.step3: Copy the key and paste it above.

openrouter.title: How to get your OpenRouter key
openrouter.step2: Click **Create API Key**, and add credits if your balance is empty.
openrouter.step3: Copy the key (it starts with `sk-or-`) and paste it above. It is shown only once.

opencode.title: How to get your OpenCode key
opencode.step2: Subscribe to **OpenCode Go**, or add credits to use the Console models.
opencode.step3: Create an API key, copy it (it starts with `oc_sk_`) and paste it above.

_context.panel.groups.included: Heading of the group of AI sources that come with the Rerun plan (the Rerun credit).
_context.panel.default.change: Button that opens the picker to change the workspace default model.
_context.panel.default.via: {source} is the name of the connection the default model runs through.
_context.panel.default.stopped: {source} is the name of the broken connection.
_context.status.paused: Badge: the Rerun credit is paused.
_context.subtitle.apiKey: {provider} is a provider name such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
_context.planLimits.updatedAgo: {age} is a short duration already localized, such as 5m, 3h, 2d, or a short date.
_context.planLimits.used: {percent} is a percentage already formatted, such as 42%.
_context.planLimits.usedWithReset: {percent} is a percentage already formatted. {reset} says when the limit resets, already localized.
_context.meter.planLimit: Accessible label of a progress bar. {name} is the name of a plan window, such as 5-hour or Weekly.
_context.models.count: How many of the models of this connection the coworkers can use, for example 3 of 8.
_context.opencode.count: How many models of this catalog are switched on, for example 3 of 8 on.
_context.opencode.free: Badge beside an OpenCode model: its tokens cost nothing, the provider serves it for free.
_context.remove.fallBack.agents: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.remove.fallBack.both: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.remove.released.agents: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.remove.released.both: {agents} is a comma-separated list of coworker names.
_context.chatgpt.setting.settings: Must match the label of the Settings menu in ChatGPT's own interface, in this language.
_context.chatgpt.setting.security: Must match the label of the Security section in ChatGPT's own settings, in this language.
_context.chatgpt.setting.deviceCode: Must match the label of the setting in ChatGPT's own security settings, in this language.
_context.chatgpt.adminMessage: A message the user copies and sends to their ChatGPT workspace admin. The quoted setting name must match ChatGPT's own label.
_context.chatgpt.stuck.expiredSelf: <link> points at ChatGPT's security settings; the path must match ChatGPT's own labels.
_context.chatgpt.stuck.errorSelf: <link> points at ChatGPT's security settings; the path must match ChatGPT's own labels.
_context.chatgpt.remarks.grabCode: Said by the Chief of Staff, the assistant: now get a sign-in code.
_context.claude.remarks.checking: Said by the Chief of Staff while the code is being checked; animated dots follow it.
_context.nameStep.title: Title of the last step: give the connection a name.
_context.custom.probe.unreachableCloud: {host} is a host name and port, such as localhost:11434.
_context.custom.probe.unreachableLocal: {host} is a host name and port, such as localhost:11434.
_context.custom.probe.refused: {model} is a model id. {detail} is the error the server sent back, in English.
_context.custom.probe.refusedUnnamedDetail: {detail} is the error the server sent back, in English.
_context.detail.readOnly: {reason} is a sentence without a final period that explains why the controls are disabled.
_context.sources.summary: One line under a connection in the AI providers list. {kind} is already translated, such as Plan, API key or Custom endpoint.
_context.sources.summaryWindow: One usage figure of a subscription, in the line under it. {name} is a plan window such as Session or Weekly, {percent} is already formatted, such as 42%. Several are joined with ' · '.
_context.sources.creditPaused: Line under the Rerun connection: a member paused the Rerun credit.
_context.sources.creditUsed: Line under the Rerun connection. {percent} is a whole number from 0 to 100.
_context.sources.creditUsedUpOn: Line under the Rerun connection. {date} is a short date already localized, such as Nov 12.
_context.sources.creditBackOn: A fragment the iOS app sets inside its own sentence "credits used up, back {backOn}". {date} is a short date already localized, such as Nov 12. Keep the preposition the target sentence needs.
_context.sources.creditBackNextMonth: A fragment the iOS app sets inside its own sentence "credits used up, back {backOn}", in place of a date.
_context.sources.windows.session: Name of a usage window of a Claude or ChatGPT subscription: the rolling limit of a few hours.
_context.sources.windows.fiveHour: Name of OpenCode Go's rolling usage window, five hours long. Used as an adjective before 'limit' elsewhere, such as '5-hour limit used'.
_context.sources.windows.weekly: Name of the weekly usage window of a subscription.
_context.sources.windows.monthly: Name of the monthly usage window of a subscription.
_context.sources.windows.modelWeekly: Name of the weekly usage window of one model of a subscription. {label} is a model family such as Opus.
_context.sources.windows.modelWeeklyUnnamed: Name of the weekly usage window of one model of a subscription, when the model is not named.
_context.sources.windowResets: Follows a usage figure, such as '42% used, resets in 3h'. {when} is a short relative time already localized, such as 'in 3h'.
_context.sources.tiers.fast: Hint under the Rerun Fast model in a model picker.
_context.sources.tiers.smart: Hint under the Rerun Smart model in a model picker.
_context.sources.opencodePlan.go: Hint under an OpenCode model in a model picker: paid by the OpenCode Go subscription.
_context.sources.opencodePlan.console: Hint under an OpenCode model in a model picker: paid with the OpenCode Console credits.
_context.sources.opencodePlan.free: Hint under an OpenCode model in a model picker: the provider serves it for free, nobody pays for its tokens.
_context.sources.unavailable.codexOutdated: Why a model cannot be picked: the Codex command line tool on the user's machine is too old for it.
_context.sources.unavailable.notInChatgptPlan: Why a model cannot be picked: the user's ChatGPT subscription does not include it.
_context.sources.unavailable.opencodeRetired: Why a model cannot be picked: OpenCode stopped offering it.
_context.sources.pricePerMillion: Price of an OpenCode model per million tokens. {input} and {output} are amounts already formatted, such as $2.
